newsitem.title: USA: Ferrofluidics says chairman Avery retires.
newsitem.headline: Ferrofluidics says chairman Avery retires.

text.p: Ferrofluidics Corp said Friday that Paul Avery, who joined the company in 1989, has retired as chairman of the board, director and employee of the company.
The company did not name a replacement and said it did not know when it would select one.

Avery has already given up the positions of chief executive officer and president, and that this final move completes the transitional plan that was expected when he assumed his many responsibilities in 1993.
Avery and Ferrofluidics have entered into a consulting agreement extending over the next three years, said the company.
